rsp.label: eSIM RSP ASN.1
rsp.blurb: BER tags inside ES10, ES9+ and ESipa messages. Context class BFxx and 9Fxx, application class 5Fxx.

alloc.label: ETSI TS 101 220 allocator
alloc.blurb: Every tag value ETSI actually allocates, in three encodings: COMPACT-TLV, BER-TLV and COMPREHENSION-TLV.

gp.label: GlobalPlatform BER-TLV
gp.blurb: Card and Security Domain data objects. A tag means different things in different GlobalPlatform documents, so the document is part of the key.

usat.label: 3GPP USAT (TS 31.111)
usat.blurb: The 3GPP names for USAT tags plus the reassign flag, which exists only in TS 31.111.

ef.label: SIM EF / FID file IDs
ef.blurb: File identifiers, not BER tags. The same FID carries different names under different application DFs.
